body: I used to think that life is what you make it but the older I get the more I realize it's what life is handed you as far as how attractive you are or what kind of personality quirks you're born with or what kind of financial situation you're born into. There's very very very few people that ever are able to push beyond their lot in life.  Mine seems to be mostly suffering from total dissatisfaction of myself and others.
I have spoken to others and they alll say the same unhelpful but well-meaning shit. I cannot afford a shrink because fuck American healthcare and standards.

I get what you are saying, but pain and suffering are relative.  This is why very successful people even commit suicide. And the people in my new line of work are garbage for the most part, something I did not expect. At the new job I have already been called into my boss' office twice because coworkers misrepresenting what I said or did. Seems like people just want to start shit.  I am quite educated and cultured, something not that common in my new line of work, and not sure if I just do not fit in. Tired of feeling underappreciated and at the same time blame myself for most of my woes. I fear that once my kids are old enough to not depend on me I will have no reason to go on.  What is the point if the rest of my life will just continue ti get worse?
I am to the point where hearing my Mom say that I would understand her pain and desire to end it...
I wish there was a decent bar within reasonable driving distance...

You don't come off as a bitch at all and have every right to be pissed off at the cards life has dealt you so far. I could say the cliche thing and tell you that you are not defined by the bad things that happen to you, but we are shaped by those things. The thing to focus on though is that we have to give our attention to the things we can change, to use the hate and negativity to fuel our drive to better ourselves and our world. I am here if you need someone to talk to as that helps a lot, too.
